notes: MERIDIAN v2 GAZE (No.10 front BUST at 2x figure scale, GALE v2 bust convention, re-based on GALE's BUST0 = the set's one No.10 bust model, same palette, 1 px outline). The bust runs off the bottom edge by design. contact null; pelvis = chest = the sternum (64,86) = the bust pivot (default anchor; GZ3's crouch is drawn 2 px lower against it). eyeL / eyeR = screen-left / screen-right pupils (where the eye threads leave); tip1-tip3 = index, middle, ring fingertips of the screen-left hand (his right), tip4-tip6 = the screen-right hand (GZ2/GZ2b: the loom threads leave from them going UP; the fingers are hooked over the strings); head = skull centre. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Shot 2a (x3): GZ3 0.00-0.30, GZ2 0.30-0.42, GZ2b 0.42-0.57, GZ2 0.57-0.72, GZ2b 0.72-0.80, GZ3 0.80-0.90; shot 1: GZ3 as the cached still inside the needle's-eye iris (1.26-1.40). Placement (screen2a): chest at screen (320,286) at x3 (crown y 28, eyes y 169, canvas bottom y 409, off-screen through the 1.00 -> 1.10 push); keep the chest >= y 237 so the row-127 shirt cut never shows. Studio layer: Art only (numbers in Art; no Num/Ball layer). The ball is never drawn in a frame: the game draws it at ball/boot/forehead. Studio: Sochetra / GazeFront / Front (Side/Back views blank).
